status_vocabulary.ACTIVE: Canonical input of the current benchmark version.
status_vocabulary.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by a later revision. Kept online, byte-identical, so results made with it stay checkable. Never an input of a later benchmark version.
status_vocabulary.EXPERIMENTAL: Not part of any published benchmark version. Never mixed into a statistic of ACTIVE worlds.
status_vocabulary.PRIVATE: Measured locally only. Its file, fixtures and results are never published (third-party personal data); a sanitised derivative with its own hash is needed for publication.

class_vocabulary.LAB: Synthetic world built by a generator (datapack or behaviour pack) to exercise chosen families systematically.
class_vocabulary.MANUAL_NATIVE: World built by hand in the retail game, to capture engine-authentic state that commands cannot fabricate.
class_vocabulary.REAL_WORLD_SURVIVAL: World actually played over a long period. Measures robustness on organic, multi-version content.
